identification: Mixed doll lot: one boxed nude Pullip fashion doll (Groove/Jun Planning, Japan; box has gold-frame ornate Pullip logo and a small gold label that reads roughly 'Around the Tunes' but I could not read it clearly and Google found no match, so the exact Pullip release is not identified; doll has two-tone grey/brown wig, no outfit), plus McDonald's/Madame Alexander Wizard of Oz mini dolls (Dorothy, Glinda, Tin Man, Cowardly Lion, Wicked Witch of the West), and several Cabbage Patch miniature dolls with tags, plus a bagged small doll with spool of thread.
marks_seen: Photo 1: box front with 'Pullip' script logo and small label text possibly 'Around the Tunes' (blurry); doll nude, in window box. Photo 2: group of mini dolls, Cabbage Patch Collectable yellow hang tags on three, Wizard of Oz Alexander-type dolls (Witch has Oz signature on skirt).
google_searches: Pullip Around the Tunes doll box (no match); Pullip Around the Tower/Tunes/Time brown grey hair box gold frame (no match).

entries.note: Pullip Eirene P-240, different (popular) release, boxed fashion doll; shows top of Pullip range.
Pullip ALa F-588 NRFB, sealed, different release.

viewing_check: Estimate $30-50, current bid $10. Pullip is the only valuable piece; check the box label and whether the doll is complete (nude, no stock/outfit, no accessories visible) and not damaged. Pullip prices on eBay AU run about $60 to $490 for boxed dolls depending on release; a nude boxed doll with no outfit is likely at the low end. Wizard of Oz minis are $5-$20 each. Prices are recent (2024-2026).
searches_tried: Terapeak AU: 'pullip doll' (50 rows); 'madame alexander mcdonalds wizard of oz' (14 rows). Google x2 for box label.
flip_reason: Pullip release not identified. Comparable boxed Pullips sold $60-$459 (4 sales shown, different releases); Oz minis add maybe $40-60 for the group. Current bid $10, est $30-50. Only worth it if the doll turns out to be a mid-value release; check label on viewing.

identification: Three-piece Australiana lot: vintage carved wooden (teak/stained) kangaroo bottle holder with hinged swing arm, a plush 1970s-style koala (sheepskin-look ears, vinyl nose), and a pale green moulded floral vase described as Diana Pottery 'Flora' vase, 21 cm, crazed. Diana Pottery was a Sydney maker 1940s-1970s.
marks_seen: No maker marks visible in either photo (photo 2 is a close-up of the kangaroo head and swing arm). Vase base not shown.
google_searches: teak kangaroo bottle holder vintage Australian 1970s wine bottle holder; Diana Pottery Flora vase green Australian pottery 21cm (Diana vases listed $18-$80 retail).

entries.note: Vintage hand carved wooden kangaroo bottle holder. Postage extra.

viewing_check: Estimate $30-50, current bid shown as $ (blank/low). Check the vase for the Diana mark and crazing/chips; crazed lowers value. Kangaroo holder: check arm hinge intact. Koala is a common 1970s souvenir with almost no resale value. All prices 2024-2026; stable and low.
searches_tried: Terapeak AU: 'diana pottery vase' (50 rows), 'kangaroo wine bottle holder wood' (1 row), 'vintage kangaroo bottle holder' (1 row). Google x2.
flip_reason: Only 1 same-item kangaroo sale at $44; Diana vases sell $20-60. Whole lot worth roughly $60-90 total at best; no $200 profit.

identification: Five Oriental-style ceramics: (1) Chinese blue and white prunus on cracked-ice ginger jar with lid and panels of precious objects (Kangxi-style, probably late Qing or 20th century), (2) small blue and white two-handled creamer/sugar pot with prunus sprays and key-fret border, (3) rice-pattern/enamelled jar with lid with blue border (Japanese or Chinese export style), (4) crackle-glaze baluster vase with blue calligraphy, (5) blue and white calligraphy ginger jar with lid (modern reproduction style).
marks_seen: No base marks visible; the single photo is wider than the screen (I scrolled to see all five pieces). Calligraphy on pieces 4 and 5 is decorative poem text.
google_searches: Chinese blue and white prunus ginger jar cracked ice panel precious objects antique Qing 19th century with lid (Qing examples listed $130-250 from dealers; many modern copies exist).

entries.note: Chinese prunus blossom blue white ginger jar, double circle mark base.

viewing_check: Estimate $40-80, current bid $20. Viewing: look at the prunus jar base and glaze for age (uneven, foot ring, Kangxi mark is usually later). Check lid fits, chips, hairlines. The calligraphy pieces look modern. Prices 2024-2026, flat; typical prunus jar sells $30-60 on eBay, rarer Qing pieces higher.
searches_tried: Terapeak AU: 'chinese prunus ginger jar' (20 rows), 'antique chinese ginger jar qing' (3 rows). Google x1.
flip_reason: Typical sold $30-60 for similar prunus jars (4 sales); all five pieces maybe $100-150 total. Bid $20. Fragile and heavy to post; no $200 profit.

No old (pre-1940) cards visible.

google_searches: postcard album lot 1970s Europe Vienna Rhine London modern chrome postcards value (comparables: 340-card album 1950s-70s GBP 17.99 asking; Vienna 1970s sets of 2 or 6 at a few dollars).
